title: Kids' One Piece Zoro Graphic Cotton Hoodie, Long Sleeve Pullover
intro:
Children's cotton pullover hoodie with One Piece Zoro graphics, a hood and long sleeves. Check the selected color/design in the product images.

FIT: Sizes 100–160. Compare the listed garment bust, length, shoulder and sleeve measurements with a well-fitting hoodie before selecting a size; age and height are guides only. Select the color/design first and check the available sizes. Measurements are in cm; allow the stated 2–3 cm manual measurement difference.
